title: Clinicopathologic and Ancillary Testing of Primary Clear Cell Carcinoma of the Cervix
official: Clinicopathologic and Ancillary Testing of Primary Clear Cell Carcinoma of the Cervix - a Rare Tumor
summary: This study aims to provide a comprehensive report on clinicopathologic features, immunohistochemical/biomarker testing and molecular profile of cervical clear cell carcinoma. This study may help researchers learn more about the molecular profile of cervical clear cell carcinoma.
conditions: Human Papillomavirus-Independent Cervical Adenocarcinoma, Clear Cell-Type
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients diagnosed with clear cell carcinoma of the cervix at MDACC
